note: Research notes PlateRank's AI-readability drafts cite. Each has its source URL. Collected Oct 23, 2026.

visible_text.claim: AI assistants read the visible text of a page when they fetch it; a separate test found five AI systems used only visible HTML at retrieval.

schema_no_lift.claim: Ahrefs (1,885 pages, matched test): adding JSON-LD gave no statistically significant AI-citation lift on Google AI Overviews, AI Mode or ChatGPT.

llms_txt_unused.claim: 97% of llms.txt files got zero requests in May 2026 (Ahrefs server logs); Google says llms.txt has no ranking effect.

ai_bots.claim: AI search / user bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User) are separate from training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended).

robots_is_control.claim: OpenAI and Anthropic point site owners to robots.txt to manage their crawlers.
